nodes.speaker: Receptionist
nodes.text: Welcome to the academy. Your arrival registration is ready, and the grounds are yours to explore. You're assigned to the five-student suite in Sirius.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Could I collect the suite key?

nodes.speaker: Receptionist
nodes.text: I passed it to another student earlier. Stella was heading for magical engineering in the teaching building. Ask her first; she'll know the others.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Stella, then the rest of my dorm-mates. I'll come back if the key doesn't turn up.

nodes.speaker: Receptionist
nodes.text: Have you spoken with Stella in teaching, Cinna Cirra around the commons, Orio near the forest, and Katrina in the courtyard? Finish helping them, then bring everyone back here.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: We've all come back. You said one of us had the suite key.

nodes.speaker: Receptionist
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I haven't seen any of you before. The key is still here.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: But you told our new dorm-mate you'd given it to another student.

nodes.speaker: Receptionist
nodes.text: I don't remember that. Your assignment is correct, though. Here is the key to the Sirius suite.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: We'll take it. We've spent enough of the day chasing this already.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Let's sit down in Sirius before we decide what to do.

nodes.speaker: Receptionist
nodes.text: You have your Sirius suite key. The common area is open; your sleeping room is inside the residential suite.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I should check my accommodation assignment with reception in the arrival building first.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: This is the Sirius common area. Let's finish meeting everyone and collect the key before we settle in.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: You told us what reception said. Now they say none of us had ever been there.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Maybe it was a mix-up. Maybe. I'd like to compare notes tomorrow when my brain isn't loading at two frames a second.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I want an explanation too. I also want a bed, and the bed is winning.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: I don't think we imagined it. Could we stay together tonight, and ask again in the morning?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We'll remember what happened. We don't have to solve it tonight.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Agreed. Bring the key to the residential door on the southeast side of the hall. I'll show you our suite and your room.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: The key fits. This is our group living space; the five of us will share it.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: It already feels a little less strange with everyone here.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Your sleeping room is to the east, beside the courtyard window. Follow me across the suite, then choose to rest at the bed.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Tomorrow we can worry about the receptionist. Tonight: save your energy.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Your room is east of the suite living space. Rest at the bed when you're ready. We'll talk about reception tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Morning light fills the room. For a moment it feels like arriving all over again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The key is still here. So are the questions from yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Morning. We made it through our first day together.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Chapter 1 complete.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The day's conversations keep circling in my head. Everyone is safe inside the suite. Rest until morning?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The receptionist's contradiction can wait. I close my eyes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll rest when I'm ready.
